Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

This is a part-time position focused mainly on weekends, combined with one weekday.

You will work:

 
• 
Weekend shifts: between 08:00 and 21:00

 
• 
One weekday (Monday or Friday): from 09:00 to 17:30

Flexibility regarding weekend work and the assigned weekday is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential and the main working language.

 
• 
Good knowledge of French.

 
• 
Good knowledge of German.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

 
• 
Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

 
• 
Comfortable working independently, especially during weekend shifts.

Are you commercially minded and do you enjoy working with customers? Are you looking for a job that is never the same and where you get opportunities to grow?

Then maybe you are our new CUSTOMER CARE REPRESENTATIVE!

For our client, the largest private rail freight operator in Europe, we are looking for a customer care representative to join the Freight Force.

As a customer care representative you will: Process owner for the booking & check-in process
  
• You accept bookings on customer request  
• You make bookings yourself of containers and wagons on trains and you send the booking instructions and agreements to Order Management  
• You inform and make the customer acquainted with the Customer Portal so that he is able to makes his own bookings. You assist the customer in every step of the booking process.  
• You manage changes of the original booking  
• You check if basic commercial data is known and is supported via the Customer Portal. If no, you inform and request assistance from Inside Sales to amend lacking commercial information  
• You rectify the missing and/or wrong contract number for import orders to ensure quick O2C  
• You make sure that all booking details are correct and that there are no anomalies that can slow down the order-to-cash process  
• You prepare template of the railway bill/consignment note.  
• You make the consignment note (as a paid service or if in high special need for assistance)
Commercial tasks
  
• You are able to maximize the fill rate of each train by finding the extra box/wagon and by consulting the customer on a professional and commercial way (based on parameters of Commercial Margin Management)  
• You manage the customer relation daily and (pro-) actively to create a lock-in opportunity and retain Customer satisfaction.  
• You build a customer relationship through high standard service delivery and execution.  
• You highten awareness and inform the client of successful products  
• You inform and share knowledge with other stake-holders within the company to inform and update on this new transport relation
Customer behavior
  
• You discuss and try to understand the booking behaviors and needs of the Customer via commercial discussions based on KPI’s (in relation to SLA)  
• You sharing info about the customer behavior with commercial stake-holders (commercial Margin Management/Key accountmanagers/Inside Sales/...)
Communication
  
• You are pro-actively by thinking with the customer, assessing and acting before possible incidents.  
• You assure the tracking & tracing (within office hours) via Customer Portal and other ways (digitalization is key and our future aim)  
• You receive and assist the Customer with his complaint within our organisation and stakeholders

Who are we looking for?

As a Customer Service Representative, you are primarily focused on customer service. You have a commercial mentality and are able to communicate with the customer in a professional way.
  
• You have a bachelor degree or equivalent through experience;  
• You have strong communication skills and are able to understand and translate the customers needs;  
• You speak English fluently. A good knowledge of French and Dutch is required. Knowledge of German or another language is a plus;  
• You have experience in managing an account and you are able to work on customer relations and loyalty;  
• You have knowledge of the various Microsoft Office programs and are quick to learn proprietary systems;  
• You are organized, detail-oriented and have the drive to work in a commercial and professional manner;  
• You have the necessary persuasiveness and commercial flair, are proactive and can work alone as well as in a team;  
• You are a multitasker and are someone who values efficiency;  
• You can cope with a changing environment.

For our customer in Houthalen we're searching for an Estimating Engineer.

Your key responsibilities:

• Conducting detailed analysis of project specifications and drawings to accurately estimate costs associated with materials, labor, and equipment
• Determine cost estimate targets during the design and development process, recommending cost effective solutions
• Working cross-functionally with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to gather comprehensive details for precise estimation
• Gather proposals, specifications and related documents and liaise with stakeholders in order to convert specifications to cost estimates for new and current machines
• Reviewing bids from subcontractors and vendors for conformity to project requirements and overall budgetary constraints
• Implementing best practices in cost estimation and establishing protocols for regular updating and revising of estimates
• Establish cost estimates of production processes and tooling costs and review alternatives or put forward recommendations for improvement
• Presenting, explaining, and justifying project estimates to senior management and relevant stakeholders
• Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, new technologies, and government regulations that could affect project costs
• Utilize cost methodologies and tools and appropriate software models and packages to prepare and maintain reliable and accurate data
• Assess cost effectiveness of products and track actual costs relative to budget and report status on a regular basis to ensure costs are in line with forecasts
•  Monitor and review data and information to detect or assess problems
• Investigate and identify cost reduction opportunities through cost analysis review
• Contribute to cost monitoring and reporting systems and procedures and monitor trends
• Prepare cost and expenditure statements, reports and other necessary documentation at regular intervals to share with others in the business
• Support all activities in cost estimating and take a proactive approach towards improvements
• Create sales layouts

• Relevant business or manufacturing/engineering degree preferred, BsC or MsC
• Some previous experience of cost estimating, ideally in an machine building, manufacturing or engineering environment
• Good IT systems knowledge and skills including advanced SAP and Excel skills
• Ideally experienced in the use of spreadsheets, estimating pricing models and cost management tools
• Able to show evidence of adding value and cost optimization
• Knowledge and understanding of a variety of manufacturing/automotive processes and components and ability to evaluate and analyze associated costs
• Experience in manufacturing and design environment, mechanical engineering
• Knowledge of 3D design software (Inventor, AutoCAD)
• Knowledge of various production techniques: milling, turning, welding, sheet metal working, assembly
• Good knowledge drives
• Willing to travel
• Bilingual (Dutch-English)

jobs.occupation: Technician in Electro-Mechanics (TiPODS - AURORA - STRATUS) M/W/X
jobs.description:
WHAT WE OFFER within the projects

• Highly varied job content, giving you the opportunity to work on a very wide range of novel electro-mechanical systems (air, ground, maritime) in a very international context. You will be deployed in a large variety of projects and will be required to work together with dozens of researchers and other technicians to reach objectives. To make this a bit more specific, you will be deployed as an example in these projects:
• TiPODS: To support the construction (steelwork, electronics, automation), commissioning, maintenance, and usage of a test facility for land vehicle tires testing.
• AURORA: To support the development of a new generation of demining robots with dual manipulators
• STRATUS: To develop novel drones that are composed maximally of EU-sourced & developed components
• Opportunity to work in and with an international & dynamic team of research engineers.
• The flexibility and freedom to innovate and bring your own ideas.
• The ability to have an impact and work on societally relevant topics. As an example: many of our research projects are currently seeking solutions for mine clearance in Ukraine.
• An employer that strives towards maintaining a good work-life balance for its employees.
• Training opportunities to get new practical skills and/or improve your current skills (potential example: machinery certifications, heavy trailer driving license, A2-pilot flying license).
• Possibility of travelling for field trials with partners.
 

MAIN TASKS

• Manufacture mechanical components for scientific research (machining, welding, etc.).
• Utilize specialized instruments (sensor installation, cameras, measurement devices, etc.).
• Conduct mechanical and electrical tests on test benches, ensuring compliance with international standards.
• Calibrate and test laboratory equipment for specific experiments.
• Actively contribute to all project phases, including metalwork, electrical/electronical work, technical drawing, and system assembly.
• Participate in test campaigns (including equipment preparation, maintenance, execution, and problem solving).
• Assist in procurement and maintenance of equipment (including repairs and calibration of instruments). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The applicant shall have a professional bachelor's degree in electromechanics (a level 6 qualification according to the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) or similar) and should have relevant experience in the field of electronics, metalwork, and mechatronics.

Explicitly, we are not looking for an academic profile but a technical professional profile!

 

This position is ideally open for experienced profiles (minimum 3 years of experience).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Proven experience with electro-mechanical systems and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of security measures to perform work related to electricity (certifiable BA4/BA5 or similar)
• Demonstrated ability to think outside the box and devise innovative solutions to technical challenges in the field (a "MacGyver" mindset). In other words, a problem solver
• Driving license B (or in the process of getting it).
 

¿RECOMMENDED¿ skills:

• Proven workshop experience and skills (ex: welding, electrical design, mechanical design, CNC, etc.)
• Proven experience with robotic systems and troubleshooting
• Training or experience in system integration
• Experience with electrical measurement devices
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:

• Experience in programming with Labview/ROS/Matlab/C++/Python
• Proficiency in 3D printing technologies and design software (CAD) for rapid prototyping and repairs
• Knowledge of PCB design and soldering
• Drone Pilot License can be an advantage and/or experience with flying drones
 

Personal skills:

• You are highly motivated (read proactive) to develop technical/workshop skills that are not yet mastered.
• You have a practical mindset, showcasing a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
• You take initiative, you are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.
• You improve the team-spirit and solve interpersonal conflicts. 
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have very good knowledge of French or Dutch (oral & written) and a minimum knowledge of (or be willing to learn) the other language (oral), since lots of campaigns will be performed in Belgium. This will be tested during selection.
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral & written), which will be tested during selection.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher is likely to be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European Defence Fund projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: 15 March 2027, in consultation with the applicant.
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours / week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• To be very clear: your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to a project that ends in Spring 2031. The financing of your contract beyond that period is therefore not 100% guaranteed. 
• Wage scale: NBI1. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing personnel to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. Your bruto and netto salary can be simulated precisely via this tool: simulateur de salaire.
• Holiday pay.
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a BOSA test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€/day);
• Digital allowance: 15€/month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days/week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years)
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

• Do you thrive on challenging supplier pricing and uncovering cost-saving opportunities?
• Are you equally comfortable with data analysis and commercial negotiations?
• Looking for a dynamic role in an international environment where no two days are the same?
Then this opportunity might be exactly what you're looking for.

As a Technical Buyer, you will play a crucial role in driving procurement performance across long-term projects. Your primary focus will be identifying and realizing savings opportunities while building strong, strategic relationships with suppliers. You will challenge cost increases, perform market analyses, develop compelling business cases, and negotiate optimal commercial conditions.

Our client is an international supply chain specialist serving the automotive industry. The company manages the procurement and distribution of fastening solutions and technical components for leading manufacturers worldwide.

This position combines analytical problem-solving with stakeholder management and requires someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and market conditions continuously evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze supplier price increase requests and assess their impact on procurement budgets.
• Conduct market research and benchmarking to validate pricing proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.
• Develop and present fact-based business cases to support negotiations and purchasing decisions.
• Lead commercial discussions with suppliers and negotiate the best possible pricing and contractual conditions.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing suppliers.
• Organize and participate in supplier performance reviews and business meetings.
• Monitor market trends and proactively identify risks and opportunities within the supply chain.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Manage purchasing activities for strategic, long-term projects from analysis through implementation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• 2 to 5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, procurement or a comparable commercial role.
• Proven experience in supplier negotiations and achieving measurable cost reductions.
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Commercially driven with the confidence to challenge suppliers and defend your position using facts and data.
• Experience within a technical, manufacturing or automotive-related environment is considered a strong advantage.
• Familiarity with procurement terminology, sourcing methodologies and supplier management processes.
• Fluency in English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

Your role as Team Manager Value Management
 
 

• You define the Value Management strategy and roadmap for Business Solutions, focused on retention, renewals and gross margin protection.
